name: Holy AOE
description: A gold rune circle opens and a white-gold pillar of light erupts, ringed by candle pillars, spiral ribbons, glyph tablets, feathers and warm mist.

metadata.reference: Holy Area of Effect concept sheet (heal / protect / purify / empower; 'light drives out darkness')
metadata.analysis: cast: gold rune circle + inner sigil fade in, sparkles gather inward | rise: eight candle pillars ascend from the ring, the central beam grows | peak: white-gold pillar at full height with volumetric column, spiral ribbons, glyph tablets, holy ring bands | sustain: gentle pulsing, feathers and sparkles rise | fade: pillars sink, motes drift up, the rune fades last
